integrity: The proof is analytic and uses only invariance and the unit modulus of the nonlinear phase. A packaged symbolic checker verifies the completed-square algebra. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The identity constrains compactly supported invariant probabilities but does not classify realizable barycenters, prove existence or uniqueness of a physical measure, or locate bifurcations. The original 1979 article was bibliographically verified but not available as inspected full text.
title: Phase-blind variance disk for stationary Ikeda dynamics
